about: Unit tests skipped because they fail on development, each with its reason. A test is quarantined by marking it it.skip AND listing it here; scripts/check-test-quarantine.mjs (part of pnpm lint) fails if the two disagree. Remove the entry and the .skip once the test passes. README.md, 'Checks'.

tests.test: leaves nothing cached after Log out
tests.reason: App behaviour, not the test: Log out clears the query cache, then the still-mounted shell re-creates its workspace, own-profile and notification-count queries (and asks for a session renewal) before /login replaces it, so 4 empty queries remain.
